verdict.rationale: Better Auth is an npm-installed TypeScript library that you instantiate inside your own app, and it requires your own database (SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL and more), so you control both where the auth system runs and where user data lives. Community users independently confirm that all auth data sits in their own DB with no provider lock-in ('I own all the data'), and that the adapter design makes switching databases easy. Concern about a future closed cloud is speculation, not a contradiction. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of self-hosted deployment topologies or private-instance and data-residency guidance.
